title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
hook_text: Apple Intelligence hits China in iOS 27.3
script:
Apple is finally bringing Apple Intelligence to China with iOS twenty-seven point three.
Apple made the official announcement directly on its Chinese newsroom website.
MacRumors first spotted the details before the widespread rollout.
You can test the new features first in a beta dropping on November fourth.
A full public release for all eligible users is scheduled to follow in December.
Would you buy an iPhone just to use these new features?
